Database ERD

erDiagram
    Identifiable {
        int id
    }
    Customer {
        int id
        str name
        str email "nullable, default None"
    }
    Invoice {
        int id
        int customer_id
        Priority priority
        float amount
        str note "nullable, default None"
    }
    Priority {
        enum LOW
        enum HIGH
    }
    Customer ||--o{ Invoice : "invoices"
